function.name: get_news
function.description: Returns the latest BBC world news headlines with URLs.

function.name: get_news_detail
function.description: Fetches the full text of a BBC news article by URL for a deeper summary.

url.description: The BBC article URL to fetch.

function.name: get_emails
function.description: Returns a summary of the user's recent Gmail inbox emails — sender, subject, and snippet.

max_results.description: Number of emails to fetch. Defaults to 5.

function.name: get_weather
function.description: Returns the current weather and today's outlook at the user's location.

function.name: search_wiki
function.description: Searches the user's wiki (people, projects, meetings, decisions) and the text of filed documents (guides, FAQs, notes). Returns the best matching pages, then passages from inside documents as '<title> · part n/N'. Use it whenever the user asks about past work, a meeting, a decision, someone they mentioned before, or anything a filed document might cover.

query.description: What to look for, in a few words.

function.name: read_page
function.description: Returns the full text of one wiki page, e.g. 'people/anna' or 'decisions'. Use the path shown in the wiki index or in a search_wiki result.

function.name: read_source
function.description: Returns one part of a filed document with the text around it, e.g. part 12 of 'sources/fallout-4-guide'. Use the path and part number from a search_wiki passage; ask for part+1 to keep reading.

path.description: The source page path, e.g. sources/guide.

function.name: file_source
function.description: Files something into the user's wiki as a source: an email they just heard ('file that email from Anna'), a news article from the last headlines ('save the second story'), or a note they dictate ('remember this: ...'). Use it only when the user asks for it.

ref.description: For email: the sender, subject or position in the last inbox read-out. For news: the headline, its number or the URL. For note: the text itself.

function.name: get_wikipedia
function.description: Searches English Wikipedia for a topic and returns the best article's title, a one-paragraph summary and its URL. Only after the user agreed to check Wikipedia, or when they ask for it outright.

query.description: The topic to look up, e.g. 'Ada Lovelace'.

function.name: read_wikipedia
function.description: Reads one named section of a Wikipedia article (by article title and section heading).

title.description: The exact article title from get_wikipedia.

section.description: The section heading to read, e.g. 'Early life'.
